privacySections.title: 1. Controller
privacySections.text: The person named in the Legal notice (Impressum) is responsible for data processing on this website. For privacy questions, please use the email address given there.

privacySections.title: 2. Hosting (GitHub Pages)
privacySections.text: This website is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub Inc., 88 Colin P. Kelly Jr. Street, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. When you visit the site, GitHub processes technically necessary data (server log files), in particular your IP address, date and time of access, the page requested, the referring page, and your browser and operating system. This is required to deliver the website and keep it secure (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Transfers to the USA are based on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or the EU Standard Contractual Clauses. More information: https://docs.github.com/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement

privacySections.title: 3. No cookies, no tracking
privacySections.text: This website itself sets no cookies and uses no analytics or tracking services. Fonts are loaded from this website, not from external providers.

privacySections.title: 4. Videos and audios from Filmmakers
privacySections.text: Some videos and all audios are loaded from Filmmakers Europe, a service of filmmakers.one GmbH, Gocher Str. 19, 50733 Cologne, Germany. Only when you click “Load video” on the Filmmakers video or play an audio does your browser connect to Filmmakers' servers (no data is sent to Filmmakers before that), transmitting your IP address and technical data (e.g. browser, time). Filmmakers may set its own cookies and use service providers (e.g. for error analysis). They are embedded to present my work as an actress attractively (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, your consent by clicking, and Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). More information: https://www.filmmakers.eu/en/privacy

privacySections.title: 5. Links to other websites
privacySections.text: Links to other websites (e.g. IMDb, Instagram, Crew United, Filmmakers) are plain links. No data is sent to these providers until you click a link; their privacy policies then apply.

privacySections.title: 6. Contact by email
privacySections.text: If you email me, I use your details only to answer your request (Art. 6(1)(b) or (f) GDPR). The data is deleted once it is no longer needed for that purpose and no legal retention obligations apply.

privacySections.title: 7. Your rights
privacySections.text: You have the right to access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction of processing (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20) and to object to processing (Art. 21). You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR).
